title: Ivory Coast-Burkina Faso: A border under tension
summary: On the border between Côte d’Ivoire and Burkina Faso, tensions are rising. Armed incursions by Burkinabe militias, jihadist threat, and civilians living in fear, our team got rare access, alongside the Ivorian army, to this high-risk zone. #SahelCrisis#WestAfrica #Terrorism
